faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear up your doubts about NEVVOH and task management.

items.q: What is an online task manager?
items.a: An online task manager is software that lets you create, organize, and track activities digitally. NEVVOH goes further: it integrates Kanban, team management, meeting minutes, Pomodoro timer, and personal calendar in a single platform.

items.q: How do I organize my team's tasks?
items.a: With NEVVOH, you create teams, distribute tasks on the Kanban board with drag and drop, set deadlines, and track progress in real time on the dashboard. Each member sees their responsibilities clearly.

items.q: Does NEVVOH replace tools like Trello or Asana?
items.a: Yes. NEVVOH offers equivalent features — Kanban, team management, deadlines — and also includes exclusive modules such as meeting minutes with action items, versioned work instructions, and idea registry.

items.q: Can I use NEVVOH to manage meetings?
items.a: Yes! The Meeting Minutes module lets you record participants, create action items with owners and deadlines, and automatically link tasks generated from the meeting.
Yes! NEVVOH is fully free for 1 year for any team, with automatic renewal. No credit card and no hidden charges.

items.q: How does NEVVOH's Pomodoro timer work?
items.a: The built-in timer lets you manage your work time with focused sessions, breaks, and countdown. You can associate the timer with specific tasks to measure time spent on each activity.
